Bienvenue à l’Église Baptiste de l’Espoi.ht: Byenveni nan Legliz Batis Lespwa nan Okap.
Bienvenue à l’Église Baptiste de l’Espoi.en: Welcome to the Baptist Church of Hope in Cap-Haïtien.

Une confiance vivante en Dieu qui guide.ht: Yon konfyans vivan nan Bondye ki gide chak desizyon ak chak pa kominote a.
Une confiance vivante en Dieu qui guide.en: A living trust in God that guides every decision and every step of our community.

Un enseignement fidèle à la Parole de Di.ht: Yon ansèyman fidèl ak Pawòl Bondye a, nou transmèt avèk regilarite ak entegrite.
Un enseignement fidèle à la Parole de Di.en: Teaching faithful to the Word of God, shared with consistency and integrity.

Une fraternité authentique où chacun tro.ht: Yon fratènite sensè kote chak moun jwenn plas li epi grandi ansanm ak lòt yo.
Une fraternité authentique où chacun tro.en: Authentic fellowship where everyone belongs and grows alongside others.

Une compassion concrète, tournée vers le.ht: Yon konpasyon ki parèt nan aksyon pou manm yo ak tout kominote a.
Une compassion concrète, tournée vers le.en: Compassion expressed through practical care for our members and the wider community.

Une compassion concrète, tournée vers le.ht: Yon konpasyon ki parèt nan aksyon pou manm yo ak kominote a.
Une compassion concrète, tournée vers le.en: Compassion expressed through practical care for our members and the community.

Mettre nos dons et nos talents au servic.ht: Mete don ak talan nou yo nan sèvis Bondye ak pwochen nou, avèk kè kontan.
Mettre nos dons et nos talents au servic.en: Joyfully using our gifts and talents to serve God and our neighbours.

Responsable de l'orientation spirituelle.en: Responsible for spiritual direction and administrative oversight.

Prend soin du peuple de Dieu par la préd.en: Cares for God’s people through preaching, teaching, prayer and spiritual support.

Promeut l'enseignement biblique, la form.ht: Ankouraje ansèyman biblik, fòmasyon manm yo ak kwasans espirityèl.
Promeut l'enseignement biblique, la form.en: Promotes Bible teaching, member training and spiritual growth.

Encadre les jeunes, développe leur leade.ht: Akonpaye jèn yo, devlope kapasite yo pou dirije kòm kretyen epi prepare yo pou sèvi Bondye.
Encadre les jeunes, développe leur leade.en: Guides young people, develops their Christian leadership and prepares them to serve God.

Assure l'encadrement spirituel, moral et.en: Provides spiritual, moral and educational guidance for children through age-appropriate activities.

Responsable de l'organisation de la loua.en: Organises praise, worship and musical development.

Coordonne les activités d'évangélisation.en: Coordinates local evangelism and missionary work.

Assure la gestion des biens, des ressour.ht: Jere byen, resous finansye ak zafè administratif yo.
Assure la gestion des biens, des ressour.en: Manages property, financial resources and administrative affairs.

Collabore aux services spirituels et à l.ht: Kolabore nan sèvis espirityèl yo ak asistans pou manm yo.
Collabore aux services spirituels et à l.en: Assists with spiritual services and support for members.

Assure la gestion administrative, la com.ht: Jere administrasyon, kominikasyon entèn ak swivi manm yo.
Assure la gestion administrative, la com.en: Handles administration, internal communication and member follow-up.

Car là où deux ou trois sont assemblés e.ht: Paske kote de oswa twa moun reyini nan non mwen, mwen la nan mitan yo.
Car là où deux ou trois sont assemblés e.en: For where two or three gather in my name, I am there among them.

Une communauté chrétienne évangélique qu.ht: Yon kominote kretyen evanjelik ki akeyi avèk kè kontan tout moun ki vle konnen Bondye, grandi nan lafwa epi viv yon vrè fratènite.
Une communauté chrétienne évangélique qu.en: An evangelical Christian community that joyfully welcomes anyone seeking to know God, grow in faith and experience genuine fellowship.

Une église enracinée dans la Parole, tou.en: A church rooted in the Word, serving the community

L'Église Baptiste de l'Espoir du Cap-Haï.ht: Legliz Batis Lespwa nan Okap se yon enstitisyon kretyen evanjelik ki te fonde pou glorifye Bondye, anonse Levanjil Jezikri a epi kontribye nan devlopman espirityèl, moral ak sosyal kominote a.
L'Église Baptiste de l'Espoir du Cap-Haï.en: The Baptist Church of Hope in Cap-Haïtien is an evangelical Christian institution founded to glorify God, proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ and contribute to the community’s spiritual, moral and social development.

Située à la Ruelle Jean-Jacques Dessalin.ht: Li sitiye nan Ruelle Jean-Jacques Dessalines #4, Village Christophe, Vètyè, Okap. Li akeyi avèk kè kontan tout moun ki vle konnen Bondye, grandi nan lafwa epi viv yon vrè fratènite.
Située à la Ruelle Jean-Jacques Dessalin.en: Located at Ruelle Jean-Jacques Dessalines #4, Village Christophe, Vertières, Cap-Haïtien, the church joyfully welcomes everyone seeking to know God, grow in faith and experience genuine fellowship.

Naissance de l'Église Baptiste de l'Espo.ht: Fondasyon Legliz Batis Lespwa a pou glorifye Bondye epi anonse Levanjil la fidèlman nan Vètyè.
Naissance de l'Église Baptiste de l'Espo.en: The Baptist Church of Hope is founded to glorify God and faithfully proclaim the Gospel in Vertières.

Mise en place progressive des instances.ht: Mete estrikti ak ministè yo sou pye ti kras pa ti kras pou sèvi chak jenerasyon.
Mise en place progressive des instances.en: Gradually establishing bodies and ministries to serve every generation.

L'Église poursuit sa mission avec foi, a.ht: Legliz la kontinye misyon li avèk lafwa, lanmou ak angajman nan sèvis kominote a.
L'Église poursuit sa mission avec foi, a.en: The church continues its mission with faith, love and commitment to serving the community.

Former des disciples de Jésus-Christ cap.en: To form disciples of Jesus Christ who positively influence their families, communities and country through their witness, love and commitment to serving God.

Proclamer fidèlement l'Évangile de Jésus.en: Faithfully proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ

Depuis sa création, elle organise des cu.en: Since its foundation, the church has held worship services, Bible studies, prayer meetings, training and evangelism activities so that everyone can discover true hope in Jesus Christ.

L’Eglise Baptiste de l’Espoir du Cap-Hai.ht: Legliz Batis Lespwa nan Okap se yon legliz endepandan fondamantal, ki pa karismatik, ki kwè Bib la (Ansyen ak Nouvo Testaman) se Pawòl Bondye enspire a. Nan nenpòt sitiyasyon, kesyon ki pi enpòtan nou poze se: « Kisa Bib la di? ». Se poutèt sa li vle separe ak tout tradisyon lèzòm ki kont Pawòl Bondye a (Matt. 15:5-9). Se yon legliz ki gen gason kòm dirijan (I Tim. 2:8-15; I Cor. 14:33-34), ak lidè ki fidèl ak Ansyen yo, pastè yo, lòt lidè yo, legliz la ak pwogram li (I Tim. 3:8), epi ki pratike disiplin legliz (Matt. 18:15-17; I Tim.5:20). Kòm yon legliz misyonè, li ta renmen plante yon legliz nan chak vil ann Ayiti ak nan lòt peyi.
L’Eglise Baptiste de l’Espoir du Cap-Hai.en: The Baptist Church of Hope in Cap-Haïtien is an independent, fundamental, non-charismatic church that believes the Bible (Old and New Testaments) is the inspired Word of God. In every situation, its most important question is: “What does the Bible say?”. It therefore seeks to separate from human traditions that contradict God’s Word (Matt. 15:5-9). It has male leadership (I Tim. 2:8-15; I Cor. 14:33-34), leaders loyal to the Elders, pastors, other leaders, the church and its programme (I Tim. 3:8), and practises church discipline (Matt. 18:15-17; I Tim.5:20). As a missionary church, it would like to plant a church in every city in Haiti and in other countries.

Nous croyons que la Bible entière est in.ht: Nou kwè tout Bib la se Bondye ki enspire li, epi Sentespri a te pouse moun Bondye yo ekri pawòl Ekriti yo menm. Kidonk, Bib la san erè nan maniskri orijinal li yo. Bondye konsève Bib la yon fason sinatirèl, epi li se sèl otorite siprèm pou lafwa ak konduit. Li bay ankourajman, direksyon, konsolasyon ak ansèyman pou moun Bondye a resevwa fòmasyon nan jistis. (2 Tim. 3 :16-17 ; 2 Pi.1 :20-21).
Nous croyons que la Bible entière est in.en: We believe the entire Bible is inspired by God and that men of God were moved by the Holy Spirit to write the very words of Scripture. The Bible is therefore without error in its original manuscripts. God has supernaturally preserved the Bible, and it is the sole supreme authority in matters of faith and conduct. It offers encouragement, direction, comfort and instruction so that the person of God may be trained in righteousness. (2 Tim. 3 :16-17 ; 2 Pi.1 :20-21).

Nous croyons en un seul vrai Dieu exista.ht: Nou kwè nan yon sèl vrè Bondye ki egziste pou tout tan an twa moun diferan: Papa a, Pitit la ak Sentespri a. Chak moun se Bondye nèt e egalman, li posede tout nati ak atribi diven yo, epi li merite tout adorasyon ak sèvis nou. (Deut. 6 :4 ; Mt.28 :19 ; Jn. 1 :14 , 10 :30 ; 2 cor.13 :14).
Nous croyons en un seul vrai Dieu exista.en: We believe in one true God, eternally existing in three distinct persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. Each person is fully and equally God, possesses the whole divine nature and attributes, and is entirely worthy of our worship and service. (Deut. 6 :4 ; Mt.28 :19 ; Jn. 1 :14 , 10 :30 ; 2 cor.13 :14).

Nous croyons que Dieu le Père est la pre.ht: Nou kwè Bondye Papa a se premye moun Trinite a. Li etènèl, li pa chanje, li gen tout pouvwa, li konnen tout bagay, li gen tout sajès ak tout lanmou. Li jis ak sen nèt. Li soutni linivè a epi li se Mèt souveren li. Li se Papa Jezikri, Seyè ak Sovè nou an, epi Papa tout vrè kwayan yo.
Nous croyons que Dieu le Père est la pre.en: We believe God the Father is the first person of the Trinity. He is eternal, unchanging, all-powerful, all-knowing, all-wise and all-loving. He is perfectly just and holy. He sustains the universe and is its sovereign ruler. He is the Father of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ and the Father of all true believers.

Nous croyons que Jésus est la deuxième p.ht: Nou kwè Jezi se dezyèm moun Trinite a epi li se sèl Pitit etènèl Bondye a. Li te vin moun pou revele Bondye bay lèzòm, akonpli pwofesi yo epi vin Sovè limanite ki pèdi a. Lè li te vin moun, Jezi pa t janm sispann Bondye; li se moun nèt, ini yon fason enseparab nan yon sèl moun pou tout tan. Sentespri a te fè konsepsyon Jezi fèt pa mirak. Li te fèt nan vyèj Mari, li te viv san peche, epi li te mouri sou kwa a kòm ranplasan nou, yon sakrifis ekspyasyon ki sifi pou tout peche ak tout moun nan tout tan. Yo te antere li; li te leve soti vivan nan lanmò nan kò li; li te monte fizikman nan syèl la nan kò glorifye li. Li chita adwat Papa a kote li kontinye entèsede. Li pral retounen nan lè a pou pran Legliz la, ki se lamarye li. Li pral retounen sou tè a nan kò li, pèsonèlman e vizibman, pou mete fen nan istwa lèzòm epi akonpli plan etènèl Bondye a: egzekite jijman an epi tabli wayòm milenè li a, apre sa ap vini eta etènèl la. (Jean 1 :1,14, 18 ; 3 :16 ; Luc1 :30-35 ; Phil.2 :5-8 ; col.2 :3,9 ; Marc10 :45 ; Actes 2 :22-24 ; Jean1 : 29 ; Rom.3 :25-26 ; Hé.10 :5-14 ; I Pie.2 :24, 3 :18 ; Jean20 :20 ; Phil.3 :20-21 ; Hé.1 :3 ;Rom.8 :34 ; I Jean2 :1 ; Actes1 :11 ; Hé.9 :28 ; I Thess.4 :13-18 ; 2Thess.2 :7 ; Mt.24 :44 ; Ap.19 :11-21 ; Ap.21-22).
Nous croyons que Jésus est la deuxième p.en: We believe Jesus is the second person of the Trinity and the eternal, only Son of God. He became flesh to reveal God to humankind, fulfil prophecy and become the Saviour of lost humanity. In becoming human, Jesus never ceased to be God; he is fully human, inseparably united in one person forever. Jesus was miraculously conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of the virgin Mary. He lived a sinless life and died on the cross as our substitute, an atoning sacrifice sufficient for all sins and all people of every age. He was buried, rose bodily from the dead and physically ascended to heaven in his glorified body. He is seated at the Father’s right hand, carrying out his ministry of intercession. He will return in the air to take the Church, his bride, and will return to earth bodily, personally and visibly to bring human history to its conclusion and fulfil God’s eternal plan by executing judgement and establishing his millennial kingdom, followed by the eternal state. (Jean 1 :1,14, 18 ; 3 :16 ; Luc1 :30-35 ; Phil.2 :5-8 ; col.2 :3,9 ; Marc10 :45 ; Actes 2 :22-24 ; Jean1 : 29 ; Rom.3 :25-26 ; Hé.10 :5-14 ; I Pie.2 :24, 3 :18 ; Jean20 :20 ; Phil.3 :20-21 ; Hé.1 :3 ;Rom.8 :34 ; I Jean2 :1 ; Actes1 :11 ; Hé.9 :28 ; I Thess.4 :13-18 ; 2Thess.2 :7 ; Mt.24 :44 ; Ap.19 :11-21 ; Ap.21-22).

Nous croyons que le Saint-Esprit est la.ht: Nou kwè Sentespri a se twazyèm moun Trinite a. Li te vini espesyalman jou Lapannkòt la pou glorifye Kris epi bay lèzòm kapasite pou resevwa delivrans Kris la akonpli a. Li se prensipal ajan ki konvenk moun sou peche yo epi ki fè yo fèt ankò. Ansanm ak delivrans lan, Sentespri a bay yon lavi nouvo epi li batize kwayan an nan kò Kris la, ki se legliz li. Li rete nan kwayan an pou tout tan epi li sele li avèk asirans pou jou redanmsyon an. Sentespri a ranpli, dirije epi kontwole kwayan ki soumèt devan li yo; li bay yo kapasite pou pote fwi epi fòs pou viv lib anba dominasyon peche.
Nous croyons que le Saint-Esprit est la.en: We believe the Holy Spirit is the third person of the Trinity, who came especially on the day of Pentecost to glorify Christ and enable people to receive the salvation accomplished by Christ. He is the primary agent of conviction of sin and regeneration. At salvation, the Holy Spirit grants new life and baptises the believer into Christ’s body, his church. He permanently indwells the believer and securely seals them for the day of redemption. The Holy Spirit fills, guides and governs believers who submit to him, enables them to bear fruit and empowers them to live free from the domination of sin.

Nous croyons également que le Saint-Espr.ht: Nou kwè tou Sentespri a bay kwayan yo don espirityèl pou bati legliz la selon ansèyman Ekriti yo. (I Cor. 13 :8 ; 14 :22 ; Jean 16 :7-15 ; I cor. 6 :19, 12 :13 ; Eph.1 :13-14 , 4 :30 ; Gal 5 :16-17 , 22-23 ; Rom.8 :5-13 ; I pie.4 :10-11 ; Rom.12 :3-8).
Nous croyons également que le Saint-Espr.en: We also believe the Holy Spirit gives spiritual gifts to believers to build up the church in accordance with the teaching of Scripture. (I Cor. 13 :8 ; 14 :22 ; Jean 16 :7-15 ; I cor. 6 :19, 12 :13 ; Eph.1 :13-14 , 4 :30 ; Gal 5 :16-17 , 22-23 ; Rom.8 :5-13 ; I pie.4 :10-11 ; Rom.12 :3-8).

Nous croyons que l’homme a été créé à l’.ht: Nou kwè Bondye te kreye lòm nan imaj li pa yon aksyon dirèk, se pa t rezilta evolisyon. Li te kreye lòm pou glorifye li, adore li, sèvi li epi viv an kominyon avèk li. Lòm te tonbe nan peche lè li te dezobeyi Bondye, sa ki te pote lanmò fizik ak espirityèl epi separe li ak Bondye. Konsa, nati lòm vin kowonpi. Li pèdi nèt, li mouri nan peche ak fot li yo, epi li pa kapab sove tèt li oswa retabli yon relasyon jis avèk Bondye grasa pwòp merit ak efò li. (Gen. 1 :26, 2 :6 , 17 :3,17 -24 ; Es.59 :1-2 ; Rom. 3 :9-19, 23,5 :6-8 Luc18 :26 -27 ; Eph.2 :1-3).
Nous croyons que l’homme a été créé à l’.en: We believe humankind was created in God’s image by a direct act of God, not as a result of evolution. People were created to glorify, worship and serve God and to have fellowship with him. Humankind fell into sin by disobeying God, bringing physical and spiritual death and separation from God. Human nature was thus corrupted; people are wholly lost, dead in their sins and trespasses, and completely unable to save themselves or restore a right relationship with God through their own merit or efforts. (Gen. 1 :26, 2 :6 , 17 :3,17 -24 ; Es.59 :1-2 ; Rom. 3 :9-19, 23,5 :6-8 Luc18 :26 -27 ; Eph.2 :1-3).

Nous croyons que Satan est l’instigateur.ht: Nou kwè Satan se moun ki pouse sa ki mal la, li se yon vrè èt espirityèl, se pa sèlman yon reprezantasyon sa ki mal. Li se yon zanj ki tonbe, ki gouvène tè a pou yon tan avèk pèmisyon souveren Bondye. Li te bat nèt sou kwa a, men Bondye ranvwaye egzekisyon jijman li jouk nan fen wayòm milenè a, lè yo pral jete li nan letan dife etènèl la. Pandanstan, li twonpe mond lan epi li chèche tabli wayòm li sou tè a, yon fo kopi wayòm Bondye a, pou diskredite ak blasfeme Bondye, epi tante, akize, atake ak detwi kwayan yo. Kwayan yo kapab reziste li atravè lafwa, lè yo konte sou pouvwa Sentespri a. (Gen.3 :1-5 ;Es.14 :12-17 ; Ez.28 :11-19 ; Job1-2 ; I Jn. 5 :19 ; 2cor.11 :14 ; I Tim.3 :6 ; I Pie 5 :8-9 ; Jacques 4 :7 ; Ap.12:9, 20:1-3,7-10).
Nous croyons que Satan est l’instigateur.en: We believe Satan is the instigator of evil and a real spiritual being, not merely a personification of evil. He is a fallen angel who temporarily rules the earth under God’s sovereign permission. He was completely defeated at the cross, but God has deferred the execution of his judgement until the end of the millennial kingdom, when he will be cast into the eternal lake of fire. Meanwhile, he deceives the world and seeks to establish a counterfeit of God’s kingdom on earth, to discredit and blaspheme God and to tempt, accuse, attack and destroy believers. Believers can resist him through faith, relying on the power of the Holy Spirit. (Gen.3 :1-5 ;Es.14 :12-17 ; Ez.28 :11-19 ; Job1-2 ; I Jn. 5 :19 ; 2cor.11 :14 ; I Tim.3 :6 ; I Pie 5 :8-9 ; Jacques 4 :7 ; Ap.12:9, 20:1-3,7-10).

Nous croyons que le sang versé par Jésus.ht: Nou kwè san Jezikri te vèse sou kwa a se sèl baz padon peche ak delivrans, ki se kado gratis favè Bondye a. Delivrans lan vin efikas atravè travay Sentespri a ki fè moun fèt ankò. Moun pa kapab jwenn li grasa zèv oswa merit pèsonèl yo. Yon moun resevwa delivrans lè li mete lafwa li nan travay Jezikri fin akonpli a. Repantans ak lafwa nesesè pou fè eksperyans delivrans. Repanti se vire do bay peche; kwè se vire jwenn Kris. Levanjil la se pouvwa Bondye pou delivre nenpòt moun ki kwè. Moun ki resevwa Jezikri pa lafwa fèt ankò, yo jwenn padon peche, yo vin pitit Bondye ak yon nouvo kreyasyon nan Kris. Sentespri a sele yo jouk jou redanmsyon an, epi pouvwa Bondye a kenbe yo. Kidonk, moun ki sove toutbon yo sove pou tout tan. (Eph. 1:7,13-14 ; Jn.1:12-13, 3:1-7, 14-16 ; 2cor.5 :17 ; Rom.1 :16,10 :9-10 ; Eph.2 :8-10 ; Rom.8 :14-17, 31-39 ; Jn.10:27-29, 14 :6 ; Actes 2 :20 ; I pie1:3-5).
Nous croyons que le sang versé par Jésus.en: We believe the blood Jesus Christ shed on the cross is the sole basis for forgiveness of sins and salvation, the free gift of God’s grace. Salvation takes effect through the regenerating work of the Holy Spirit and cannot be earned through human works or personal merit. A person receives salvation by placing faith in the finished work of Jesus Christ. Repentance and faith are essential to experiencing salvation: repentance means turning away from sin, and faith means turning to Christ. The Gospel is God’s power for the salvation of everyone who believes. Those who receive Jesus Christ by faith are born again, have their sins forgiven, become children of God and a new creation in Christ, and are sealed by the Holy Spirit until the day of redemption, kept by God’s power. Those who are truly saved are therefore eternally saved. (Eph. 1:7,13-14 ; Jn.1:12-13, 3:1-7, 14-16 ; 2cor.5 :17 ; Rom.1 :16,10 :9-10 ; Eph.2 :8-10 ; Rom.8 :14-17, 31-39 ; Jn.10:27-29, 14 :6 ; Actes 2 :20 ; I pie1:3-5).

Nous croyons que chaque chrétien devrait.ht: Nou kwè chak kretyen ta dwe viv pou Kris olye pou li viv pou tèt li. Pa pouvwa Sentespri ki rete nan kwayan yo, li ta dwe kite Kris manifeste lavi li atravè li pou glwa Bondye. Grasa yon obeyisans k ap grandi anvè Pawòl Bondye a, chak kwayan ta dwe vin gen matirite epi vin sanble ak Jezi pi plis. Pa pouvwa Lespri a, chak kwayan ta dwe viv yon lavi sen, pa satisfè dezi lachè, sèvi ak don espirityèl li yo pou bati kò Kris la, temwaye pou Kris, angaje pèsonèlman nan fè disip pou akonpli lòd misyonè Kris la, fè bon zèv epi pote fwi pou glwa Bondye. (Gal.2 :20 ; I pie.1 :15- 16, 2 :11 ; 2 cor.5 :14-15 ; Rom. 6 :11-13 ; Eph.2 :10,4 :11-12,4 :22-24 ; I pie 4 :10-11 ; Actes1 :8 ; Mt.28:18-20; col.1:10; Jn.15:8,16).
Nous croyons que chaque chrétien devrait.en: We believe every Christian should live for Christ rather than for themselves and, through the power of the indwelling Holy Spirit, allow Christ to express his life through them for God’s glory. Through growing obedience to God’s Word, every believer should mature and become increasingly like Jesus. By the Spirit’s power, every believer should live a holy life, resist the desires of the flesh, use their spiritual gifts to build up Christ’s body, witness for Christ, personally commit to making disciples in fulfilment of Christ’s missionary command, do good works and bear fruit for God’s glory. (Gal.2 :20 ; I pie.1 :15- 16, 2 :11 ; 2 cor.5 :14-15 ; Rom. 6 :11-13 ; Eph.2 :10,4 :11-12,4 :22-24 ; I pie 4 :10-11 ; Actes1 :8 ; Mt.28:18-20; col.1:10; Jn.15:8,16).

Nous croyons que l’Eglise est le corps d.ht: Nou kwè Legliz la se kò Kris la; Jezi se tèt li, epi manm li yo se moun ki resevwa Kris toutbon pa lafwa. Legliz lokal la se yon ekspresyon vizib kò Kris la nan yon kote presi. Paske manm kò Kris la ini nan Kris pa menm Lespri a, yo ta dwe viv nan lanmou, amoni ak inite. Objektif Legliz la se fè moun ki pèdi yo konnen Kris, bati moun ki sen yo epi glorifye Bondye sou tè a. (Actes 1: 8 ; I cor. 12:12-27 ; Eph.1:20-23 ,4 :1-6,4:12-16 ; Mat.28 :18-20 ; Jn.17 ; col. 1 :24-29).
Nous croyons que l’Eglise est le corps d.en: We believe the Church is Christ’s body, with Jesus as its head and those who have truly received Christ by faith as its members. The local church is a tangible expression of Christ’s body in a particular place. Because the members of Christ’s body are united in Christ by the same Spirit, they should live in love, harmony and unity. The Church’s purpose is to make Christ known to the lost, build up the saints and glorify God on earth. (Actes 1: 8 ; I cor. 12:12-27 ; Eph.1:20-23 ,4 :1-6,4:12-16 ; Mat.28 :18-20 ; Jn.17 ; col. 1 :24-29).

Nous croyons que les Ecritures prescrive.ht: Nou kwè Ekriti yo bay legliz la de òdonans: batèm ak Sent Sèn. Batèm pa imèsyon se yon aksyon obeyisans ki vini apre delivrans. Li reprezante senbolikman lanmò kwayan an parapò ak peche, antèman ansyen lavi a ak rezirèksyon nan yon lavi nouvo. Sent Sèn nan selebre inyon ak kominyon avèk Kris, li raple lanmò li senbolikman epi li anonse dezyèm vini li. (Mat.28 :19 ; Actes 10 :47-48 ; Luc22 :19-20 ; I cor.11 :23-28 ; Rom.6 :3-4).
Nous croyons que les Ecritures prescrive.en: We believe Scripture prescribes two ordinances for the church: baptism and the Lord’s Supper. Baptism by immersion is an act of obedience following salvation. It symbolises the believer’s death to sin, the burial of the old life and resurrection to new life. The Lord’s Supper celebrates union and communion with Christ, symbolically commemorates his death and anticipates his second coming. (Mat.28 :19 ; Actes 10 :47-48 ; Luc22 :19-20 ; I cor.11 :23-28 ; Rom.6 :3-4).

Nous croyons qu’à la mort chaque croyant.ht: Nou kwè lè yon kwayan mouri, li antre touswit e konsyan nan prezans ak kominyon Seyè a, pandan l ap tann rezirèksyon ak glorifikasyon kò li lè Kris retounen. Konsa, kwayan an ap jwi lavi etènèl avèk Bondye; li ap viv an kominyon avèk li, sèvi li epi adore li pou tout tan. (2cor.5 :6 ; Icor. 15 :12-58 ; Luc 23 :39-43 ; I Thess. 4 :13-18 ; Jn.3 :16 ; Ap. 21-22).
Nous croyons qu’à la mort chaque croyant.en: We believe that at death every believer immediately and consciously enters the Lord’s presence and fellowship, awaiting the resurrection and glorification of their body at Christ’s return. The believer will thus enjoy eternal life with God, share fellowship with him, serve him and worship him forever. (2cor.5 :6 ; Icor. 15 :12-58 ; Luc 23 :39-43 ; I Thess. 4 :13-18 ; Jn.3 :16 ; Ap. 21-22).

Nous croyons qu’à la mort chaque incroya.ht: Nou kwè lè yon moun ki pa kwè mouri, li antre touswit e konsyan nan separasyon ak Seyè a, pandan l ap tann rezirèksyon fizik kò li pou yo jije li epi kondane li nan lanfè etènèl. (Luc16 :19-31; Jn.3:18,36; Ap.20:5,11-15; 2 Thess. 1:5-10).
Nous croyons qu’à la mort chaque incroya.en: We believe that at death every unbeliever immediately and consciously enters a state of separation from the Lord, awaiting the physical resurrection of their body to be judged and condemned to eternal hell. (Luc16 :19-31; Jn.3:18,36; Ap.20:5,11-15; 2 Thess. 1:5-10).

Nous croyons que le prochain événement p.ht: Nou kwè pwochen evènman pwofetik la se anlevman Legliz la, lè Seyè Jezikri ap retounen nan lè a pou pran kwayan yo avèk li (Jn.14 :1-3 ; Tite2 :11-14 ; Icor.15 :51-52 ;1 Thess.4 :13-18 ; Phil.3 :20-21). Apre anlevman Legliz la, ap gen sèt ane Gran Tribilasyon an, pou akonpli Dan.9 :24-27 jan Ap. 6 :1-19:21 dekri sa. Pandan peryòd sa a, Izrayèl ap pirifye, lemonn antye ap pase anba eprèv, epi kòlè Bondye ap vide kont peche. (Jer.30:7; Mt. 24; Ap. 3:10; I Thess 5:9-11).
Nous croyons que le prochain événement p.en: We believe the next prophetic event will be the rapture of the Church, when the Lord Jesus Christ returns in the air to take believers with him (Jn.14 :1-3 ; Tite2 :11-14 ; Icor.15 :51-52 ;1 Thess.4 :13-18 ; Phil.3 :20-21). The rapture will be followed by the seven-year Great Tribulation, fulfilling Dan.9 :24-27 as described in Rev. 6:1–19:21. During this period, Israel will be purified, the whole world tested and God’s wrath poured out against sin. (Jer.30:7; Mt. 24; Ap. 3:10; I Thess 5:9-11).

Nous croyons qu’au terme de la Grande Tr.ht: Nou kwè nan fen Gran Tribilasyon an, dezyèm faz dezyèm vini Seyè Jezikri a ap fèt. Li ap retounen sou tè a pèsonèlman e fizikman menm jan li te monte a, men fwa sa a avèk gwo pouvwa ak glwa pou egzekite jijman epi inogire Wayòm Milenè a. Li pral gouvène sou tè a pandan mil ane avèk jistis ak lapè pou akonpli pwomès alyans ki fèt avèk Izrayèl la. (Actes 1 :8-11 ; Ap.19 :11- 21 ; Ez.37 :21-28 ;Es.11 :9 ; Ap.20 :1-6).
Nous croyons qu’au terme de la Grande Tr.en: We believe that at the end of the Great Tribulation, the second phase of the Lord Jesus Christ’s second coming will occur. He will return to earth personally and physically as he ascended, but this time with great power and glory to execute judgement and inaugurate the Millennial Kingdom. He will reign on earth for one thousand years in righteousness and peace, fulfilling the promise of the covenant made with Israel. (Actes 1 :8-11 ; Ap.19 :11- 21 ; Ez.37 :21-28 ;Es.11 :9 ; Ap.20 :1-6).

Nous croyons que le règne de Christ pour.ht: Nou kwè apre mil ane Kris ap gouvène sou tè a, ap gen jijman final Satan, yo pral jete li nan letan dife a pou tout tan; rezirèksyon fizik moun ki pa kwè yo ak jijman gwo Twòn Blan an; kreyasyon nouvo syèl ak yon nouvo tè; epi eta etènèl la.
Nous croyons que le règne de Christ pour.en: We believe Christ’s thousand-year reign on earth will be followed by Satan’s final judgement and his being cast into the lake of fire forever; the bodily resurrection of unbelievers and the judgement of the Great White Throne; the creation of new heavens and a new earth; and the eternal state.
